# GenMyo

> GenMyo is an inner wellness platform delivered entirely through WhatsApp. Its core experience, The Mirror Project by GenMyo, is a guided reflection — a few honest questions, asked slowly, that help you reconnect with yourself and see what's actually going on. Not therapy. Not another app. No advice. GenMyo is not therapy, not a diagnostic tool, and not a crisis service.

## Organization
- **Name:** GenMyo
- **Website:** https://genmyo.ai/
- **Category:** Inner wellness (guided reflection on WhatsApp)
- **Core product:** The Mirror Project by GenMyo
- **Contact:** hello@genmyo.ai

## Start here (canonical pages)
- **Home:** https://genmyo.ai/ — Product overview, reflection sample, boundaries, and how to begin.
- **How it works:** https://genmyo.ai/how-it-works — Step-by-step flow for starting a reflection on WhatsApp.
- **Inner weather quiz:** https://genmyo.ai/quiz — Six questions; surfaces an inner weather profile (storm, press, fog, still) and where to begin; optional path before join.
- **Join / register:** https://genmyo.ai/join — Save details to begin; quiz results can be carried into this form when coming from /quiz.
- **Stories:** https://genmyo.ai/stories — Community reflection stories and anonymized excerpts.
- **Philosophy:** https://genmyo.ai/philosophy — Slow tech, no streaks, no advice, inner alignment.
- **100 conversations report:** https://genmyo.ai/100-conversations — Research-style findings from guided reflections.
- **Blog:** https://genmyo.ai/blog — Articles on reflective practice and product updates.
- **Team:** https://genmyo.ai/team — Founders and advisors.
- **Partners:** https://genmyo.ai/partners — Employers, coaches, and therapists.
- **Privacy:** https://genmyo.ai/privacy — Data retention, human access, deletion.
- **Terms:** https://genmyo.ai/terms — Terms of service and WhatsApp opt-in.
